def.name: interpret
def.body:
line = 0
viola
loop do
  print("Awasunu(main):(#{line}): ")
  new_token = gets.not_nil!.chomp
  split_string = new_token.split(" ")
  size_limit = split_string.size.to_i
  index = 0
  if new_token == "viola"
    Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.viola
  else
    if new_token == "encrire"
      print("...")
      notes = gets.not_nil!.chomp
      print(" >>> ")
      Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.encrire(notes)
    else
      if new_token == "encrireln"
        print("...")
        notes = gets.not_nil!.chomp
        print(" >>> ")
        Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.encrireln(notes)
      else
        if new_token == "mange"
          print("...")
          notes = gets.not_nil!.chomp.split(" ")
          print(" >>> ")
          Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.mange(notes[0], notes[1])
        else
          if new_token == "osv"
            print(" >>> ")
            word_types = gets.not_nil!.chomp.split(" ")
            Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.osv(word_types[0], word_types[1], word_types[2])
          else
            if new_token == "sov"
              print(" >>> ")
              word_types = gets.not_nil!.chomp.split(" ")
              Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.sov(word_types[0], word_types[1], word_types[2])
            else
              if new_token == "object first"
                print(" >>> ")
                word_types = gets.not_nil!.chomp.split(" ")
                a = osv(word_types[0], word_types[1], word_types[2])
                b = sov(word_types[3], word_types[4], word_types[5])
                Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.expression(a, b)
              else
                if new_token == "subject first"
                  print("...")
                  word_types = gets.not_nil!.chomp.split(" ")
                  a = sov(word_types[0], word_types[1], word_types[2])
                  b = osv(word_types[3], word_types[4], word_types[5])
                  Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.expression(a, b)
                else
                  if new_token == "parle grammaire"
                    print("...")
                    word_types = gets.not_nil!.chomp.split(" ")
                    Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.write(parle_grammaire(word_types[0], word_types[1], word_types[2]))
                  else
                    if new_token == "floating finger"
                      Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.print("...")
                      fragment_one = gets.not_nil!.chomp
                      print("...")
                      fragment_two = gets.not_nil!.chomp
                      Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.floating_finger(fragment_one, fragment_two)
                    else
                      if new_token == "cerberus piano"
                        print("...")
                        datapoints = gets.not_nil!.chomp.split(" ")
                        Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.cerberus_piano(datapoints[0], datapoints[1], datapoints[2], datapoints[3])
                      else
                        if new_token == "scatter ashes"
                          puts("_After Sorting_")
                          system("./bin/scatter_ashes")
                        else
                          if new_token == "exit"
                            abort
                          else
                            Awasunudelingua::Interpreter.write("_undefined function_")
                          end
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  line = line + 1
end

objet = o
subjet = s
verb = v
"#{objet} #{subjet} #{verb}"

def.name: parle_grammaire
def.body:
verb = v
objet = o
subjet = s
"[ verb: '#{verb}', objet: '#{objet}', subject: '#{subjet}' ]"

def.name: sov
def.body:
objet = o
subjet = s
verb = v
"#{subjet} #{objet} #{verb}"
